items.headline: High Surf Advisory issued October 10 at 1:51PM PDT until October 11 at 10:00PM PDT by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
items.description:
* WHAT... For the Coastal Flood Advisory, minor to moderate
coastal flooding can be expected near times of high tide,
especially with the Sunday morning high tide. Localized damage
is possible in most vulnerable low-lying areas. For the High
Surf Advisory, large breaking waves of 5 to 8 feet with
dangerous rip currents is expected on Sunday.

* WHERE...Ventura County Beaches.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, until 2 PM PDT Tuesday.
For the High Surf Advisory, from 6 AM to 10 PM PDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Sea-water flooding of beach and harbor roads, parking
lots, and walkways is likely, especially around the time of high
tide. Isolated damage is possible during the Sunday morning high
tide which is expected to peak around 8 feet. The most
vulnerable locations to coastal flooding will be low-lying areas
from Ventura to LA county line. Localized pockets of Highway 1
between Point Mugu and LA county line could see significant surf
spray and some sea-water on the roadway. Significant beach
erosion is expected. There is an increased risk for ocean
drowning. Rip currents can pull swimmers and surfers out to sea.
Large breaking waves can cause injury, wash people off beaches
and rocks, and capsize small boats near shore.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...High tides approaching 8 feet will be
likely on Sunday morning (nearly 2 feet above astronomical high
tide of 6.1 feet), returning to around 7.5 feet for Monday and
Tuesday mornings. Large secondary high tides are also expected
each evening.
items.instruction:
Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone property. Do
NOT drive around barricades or through water of unknown depth.

Remain out of the water due to dangerous surf conditions, or stay
near occupied lifeguard towers. Rock jetties can be deadly in
such conditions, stay off the rocks.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 10 at 2:08PM PDT until October 11 at 9:00PM PDT by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Hazardous sea conditions.

* WHERE...Portions of the coastal waters of southwest
California.

* WHEN...From 6 PM this evening to 9 PM PDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...See the Coastal Waters Forecast (CWFLOX)
for more.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
